hero_sub: A Wide Range, Short Transit and Steady Quality
hero: Motorcycles are how most of Nepal gets around, so dealers and workshops need a dependable flow of spares for many different models. As a motorcycle spare parts supplier for Nepal, we make clutch and engine spares for several popular bikes at our IATF 16949 certified factory in Delhi.
Producing the parts ourselves, with CNC machining, die casting and heat treatment, keeps specifications steady from one order to the next.
Because Nepal is close by, orders travel overland, which shortens transit and makes it easier to top up stock between larger orders.

faqs: Can one consignment include spares for many models?
Yes. Each model is boxed separately and labelled, so stock is easy to sort.
Do you make the parts yourselves?
Yes. They are manufactured in our own plant in Delhi under IATF 16949 quality systems.
Can you help me choose what to stock?
Yes. Share your model list and our team will recommend parts and quantities.
How are spares delivered to Nepal?
By road from India in protective packing, with documents prepared for border clearance.
